sn47.16:1.2: Then the Venerable Uttiya approached the Blessed One …
sn47.16:1.3: all as in preceding sutta down to: …
sn47.16:2.6: based upon virtue, established upon virtue, you develop these four establishments of mindfulness in such a way, you will go beyond the realm of Death.”
sn47.16:3.1: Then the Venerable Uttiya, having delighted and rejoiced in the Blessed One’s words, rose from his seat …
sn47.16:3.4: And the Venerable Uttiya became one of the arahants.
